features.name: Authentication & Admin Panel
features.description: Admin authentication system with role-based access control (SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, EDITOR). Admin panel for managing all site content.

features.name: Package Management
features.description: CRUD operations for road assistance packages. Admin can create, edit, delete packages. Public can view and purchase packages.

features.name: Service Management
features.description: CRUD operations for road assistance services (towing, battery, tire, fuel, etc.). Admin manages services, public views them.

features.name: Application/Form Management
features.description: Package purchase application form system. Users fill multi-step form, applications are stored and emails are sent.

features.name: Slider Management
features.description: Hero slider management system. Admin can create, edit, delete slider items with images and content.

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: Site settings management (contact info, social media, working hours). Admin can update settings, public can view them.

features.name: Email Service
features.description: Email sending service using Resend API. Sends application notifications and other emails.

features.name: File Upload
features.description: File upload service using Vercel Blob. Handles image uploads for sliders and other content.

features.name: Public Website Sections
features.description: Public-facing website sections including hero, stats, services, packages, features, and CTA sections.

features.name: API Utilities & Validation
features.description: API utility functions, validation helpers, and error handling for all API routes.

features.name: Location Data
features.description: City and district data management. Provides location data for forms and applications.

features.name: Vehicle Brands Data
features.description: Vehicle brand and category data for application forms.

features.name: Admin Search & Notifications
features.description: Global search functionality and notifications system for admin panel.

features.name: Statistics API
features.description: Statistics endpoint for admin dashboard showing application counts and metrics.

features.name: SEO & Structured Data
features.description: SEO optimization with structured data (Schema.org), sitemap, and robots.txt.
